items.text: Leo Brennan and Sam Rivera are partners and celebrated their 5-year anniversary on Thursday with the tasting menu at Marigold Room.
Sam gave Leo a framed periodic table print in his own hand lettering for their 5-year anniversary.
Leo's birthday is on the 30th in October, and he is turning 33.
Leo and Sam spent four days in Door County and ate cherry pie every single day.
Leo teaches at Ashby High.
Leo is teaching AP Chemistry for the first time, with one AP section and three regular chem sections.
Leo's first day of school was August 25.
Leo's AP class has 28 kids.
Priyanka is a student in Leo's AP class who found a typo in his syllabus on day two.
Leo's department head is Rosa Duarte, who gave him her old AP lab binder.
Leo's commute is the Blue Line plus a ten-minute walk, taking forty minutes door to door.
Leo listens to podcasts during his commute and welcomes recommendations.
Leo advises the science club, which has twelve kids signed up, double last year.
The science club trip to the water reclamation plant was moved to October 24 because the bus fell through.
Leo's dad works for the water utility and is coming on the science club trip as a guest expert.
Leo's mother is named Joan.
A student knocked over a beaker of copper sulfate in Leo's classroom; everyone was fine, but the floor turned blue.
Leo has a sourdough starter named Gus.
Gus's first loaf was dense but delicious.
Leo signed up for the Prairie Lights Half Marathon on April 19.
The Prairie Lights Half Marathon runs from Lakefront to the Riverwalk and is 13.1 miles.
Leo was running about 20 miles a week when he registered for the Prairie Lights Half Marathon.
Leo noticed his knee clicking a bit on a long run.
Sam works at Northpaw Studio and was doing a branding project for a bakery.
Sam's family has gatherings in Pilsen, and Leo loves his mom's elote.
Sam wants a dog, but his and Leo's lease says no dogs.
Maddie Cho is Leo's friend and a pediatric physical therapist.
Maddie has been at Lakeview Pediatric Rehab for four years and loves working with the kids.
Maddie wants to leave Chicago winters and move to Denver for the mountains and to be closer to Grace in Santa Fe.
Maddie has lived in the same apartment by the Belmont stop for five years.
Maddie's Chicago lease ends December 31.
Maddie has a fiddle-leaf fig, and her apartment key is with the doorman.
Maddie accepted a pediatric physical therapist job at Aspen Lane Children's Therapy with a start date of January 12.
Aspen Lane Children's Therapy is a pediatric outpatient practice with lots of early intervention, which Maddie described as her dream job.
Dr. Priscilla Grant is the clinic director at Aspen Lane Children's Therapy.
Aspen Lane has a sensory gym and a tiny climbing wall.
Aspen Lane is giving Maddie $3,000 for relocation.
Maddie plans to drive to Denver the weekend of December 13.
Maddie's last day at Lakeview will be December 12.
Maddie plans to keep her new job secret at work until she gives notice on the 15th in October.
Maddie wants to live in Highland in Denver because of its cute coffee shops and proximity to a big park.
Maddie wants a goodbye party before leaving Lakeview.
Maddie's father is Paul, who offered to drive the moving truck if she moves to Denver.
Maddie's mother is Linda and plans to visit her in Denver in February.
Linda sent Maddie a list of Denver essentials with a humidifier as item one.
Leo and Sam celebrated Maddie's new job with brunch at their place and dinner at Hoshizora on Saturday the 11th in October.
Sam made frittata for Maddie's celebratory brunch.
Maddie's favorite ramen spot is Hoshizora on Milwaukee Avenue in Chicago.
Maddie's usual Hoshizora order is spicy miso with an extra egg.
Leo lent Maddie his signed copy of The Salt Orchard.
Imogen Vale signed Leo's copy of The Salt Orchard at the book fair two years ago.
Maddie is considering getting a greyhound after her move, but has not decided.
Maddie recommended Lamplight Hours, a podcast featuring interviews with people who work night shifts, and advised Leo to give it three episodes.
The Lamplight Hours episode with the bridge operator made Maddie cry.
Grace lives in Santa Fe and is engaged to Daniel.
Daniel proposed to Grace at Bandelier last month, at sunrise, as reported on 2025-08-09.
Daniel teaches welding at the community college in Santa Fe.
Grace and Daniel are thinking May for their wedding, narrowing their earlier plan of spring next year.
Grace wants an outdoor courtyard wedding venue in Santa Fe.
Casa Lumbre is Grace's favorite wedding venue and has a courtyard with old cottonwood trees.
Leo and Sam are invited to Grace and Daniel's wedding and intend to attend.
Daniel has a serious shellfish allergy.
Grace has celiac disease.
Leo hosted Grace and Daniel and made gluten-free bread for Grace.
Grace asked Maddie to be her maid of honor in Leo's bathroom during the visit.
Daniel and Sam share an interest in fonts and talked about them for an hour.
Leo Brennan teaches AP Chem and had parent-teacher conferences in October.
Leo Brennan planned a science club trip to the water plant for Friday, with his dad Mike as a guest expert.
Sam completed bakery branding with a logo of a croissant with little legs.
Rosa asked Leo Brennan to coordinate the school science fair on February 12, and he agreed.
Maddie Cho is allergic to cashews and pistachios and carries an epinephrine pen.
Leo Brennan keeps cashews and pistachios out of his kitchen when Maddie Cho visits.
Maddie Cho has been vegetarian since sophomore year of college, twelve years as of 2025-11-02.
Maddie Cho gave Leo Brennan a birthday card and merino running socks that fit perfectly.
Sam made Leo Brennan lasagna and a cake shaped like a beaker for his birthday.
Leo Brennan's physical therapist is Renee Walsh at Kinetic Way PT.
Renee diagnosed Leo Brennan's running-related knee pain as IT band syndrome.
Leo Brennan's long runs are capped at 6 miles for now, after which he can add no more than one mile per week.
Leo Brennan's PT regimen includes foam rolling and clamshells every day.
Leo Brennan is training for a half on April 19.
Leo Brennan and Sam hosted Friendsgiving at their place on November 22 at 6 pm, with about twelve people expected.
Sam was responsible for the Friendsgiving turkey, and Leo Brennan for sourdough stuffing.
Alex Moreau was bringing two pies to Friendsgiving.
Maddie Cho planned two mushroom wellingtons for Friendsgiving and confirmed her wellington was cashew-free.
Rosa and her wife and Sam's coworker Marisol were on the Friendsgiving guest list.
Leo Brennan planned cashew-free dishes and dish labels for Friendsgiving.
Leo Brennan has a sourdough starter named Gus and made a cinnamon raisin loaf.
Sam was promoted to senior designer.
Maddie Cho adopted Juniper, nicknamed JUNI or Juni, yesterday as reported on 2025-11-16.
Juni is a four years old retired racing greyhound from Second Lap Greyhound Rescue.
Juni sleeps 18 hours a day.
Juni is terrified of slippery floors and thunder, and storms make her shake.
Juni would not do stairs as of 2025-11-16, and Maddie Cho was working on it.
Juni eats salmon and sweet potato kibble because she has a sensitive stomach.
Maddie Cho's grandma Sun-ja is 84 and had a hip replacement in LA after falling and breaking her hip.
Sun-ja is still in rehab, replacing her immediate post-surgery status, and Maddie Cho's aunt will visit every day and send updates.
Sun-ja was walking with a walker a little more each day, and her physical therapists were impressed.
Maddie Cho spent Thanksgiving week in LA helping her aunt Mi-young, who hosted Thanksgiving.
Leo Brennan and Sam dog-sat Juni during Maddie Cho's Thanksgiving trip, with their landlord's permission for a visiting dog for a week.
Maddie Cho has picked up Juni, so Leo Brennan and Sam's Thanksgiving dog-sitting is complete.
During her stay, Juni stole half a loaf of Gus bread off the counter and slept on Sam for six hours.
Juni bonded with Sam and did not want to leave him when Maddie Cho picked her up.
Maddie Cho sold her couch to her coworker Kim for $200.
Maddie Cho and her dad Paul will use a rental truck for her move instead of movers after receiving a $4,000 quote.
Maddie Cho's Baker apartment in Denver fell through because the landlord sold the building and the new owner is renovating, cancelling the December 15 move-in.
Maddie Cho's replacement Denver apartment is a more expensive one-bedroom in Highland on the ground floor, with no stairs for Juni and move-in January 2.
Maddie Cho postponed her move to January 3 and will stay in Chicago until then; her Chicago lease runs through the end of December.
Maddie Cho and Paul are driving the rental truck out on January 2 and 3, with Juni getting the passenger seat on day two.
Maddie Cho sold her car last week as reported on 2025-12-21 and plans to buy something used in Denver.
Leo Brennan helped Maddie Cho pack yesterday as reported on 2025-12-21, completing their planned packing session.
Sam could not help Maddie Cho pack on Saturday the 20th because he had his work holiday party that day.
Grace and Daniel's wedding is May 16 at Casa Lumbre in Santa Fe, outdoors in the courtyard.
Leo Brennan and Sam are on Grace and Daniel's wedding guest list and said they would attend.
Maddie Cho's last day at Lakeview was scheduled for December 12, with a goodbye lunch and a card from the kids featuring Juni.
Maddie Cho had a goodbye dinner with her parents in Naperville on December 7.
At Maddie Cho's goodbye dinner, her mom cried and Paul gave her a printed map of Denver with grocery stores highlighted.
Leo Brennan's dad Mike retired after 34 years at the water utility.
Mike's retirement party took place Saturday December 13 at the VFW hall in Milwaukee, with 80 people attending.
Leo Brennan cried during his speech at Mike's retirement party.
Leo Brennan's mom organized Mike's retirement party and made a slideshow of his different mustaches.
Leo Brennan planned to end his retirement speech with a sincere memory of Mike teaching him to fix the bike.
Leo Brennan's brother Alex announced that Hana is pregnant with a baby girl due April 20.
Mike plans to spend his retirement building a crib for the baby in the garage.
Maddie Cho accidentally packed Leo Brennan's signed copy of The Salt Orchard in the box labeled 'Books (fragile)' and promised to mail it back once she is in Denver.
Leo Brennan and Maddie Cho agreed to a Presidents' Day weekend cabin visit in Elk Hollow, about two hours from Denver, February 14 to 16.
Leo Brennan and Maddie Cho agreed to split the $150 deposit for the Elk Hollow cabin.
Sam cannot join the February 14 to 16 cabin visit because he has a conference that weekend.
Leo Brennan teaches AP science students, including equilibrium.
Leo Brennan's AP class averaged 3.4 out of 5 on the February 3 mock exam.
Leo Brennan's student Priyanka got a 5 on the mock exam.
Leo Brennan's February 12 science fair involved 42 projects.
One of Leo Brennan's science fair teams qualified for regionals with water filtration using sand and charcoal.
Rosa bought Leo Brennan's whole department pizza after the science fair.
Leo Brennan submitted his application to the MEd in Science Education at Lakemont University, changing his status from applying to awaiting an interview.
Leo Brennan's intended MEd program is part-time, in the evenings, and lasts two years so he can keep teaching.
Maddie Cho edited Leo Brennan's MEd personal statement.
Rosa and Principal Hughes wrote Leo Brennan's MEd recommendation letters.
Principal Hughes described Leo Brennan as 'relentlessly curious'.
Leo Brennan's MEd interview is February 25, in person at Lakemont, at 4 pm.
Maddie Cho suggested Leo Brennan wear the blue sweater to his MEd interview.
Leo Brennan was back up to 8-mile long runs with his knee holding as of January 11.
Leo Brennan follows Renee's rule of increasing his long runs by one mile a week.
Renee discharged Leo Brennan from PT after his last session, replacing his ongoing PT treatment status.
Leo Brennan's knee exercises include clamshells.
Leo Brennan and Sam moved on February 21 to 2240 N Kestrel Ave, Apt 2, replacing their apartment-hunting plans.
Leo Brennan and Sam's new apartment is a two-bedroom in Avondale that allows dogs and has a back porch.
Alex and Hana helped Leo Brennan and Sam move, with very pregnant Hana mostly directing traffic.
Leo Brennan's bike commute is now 25 minutes following the move.
Sam's commute is now 10 minutes following the move.
Leo Brennan and Sam are waiting until after the race in April to get a dog.
Sam has already named the prospective dog Pickle.
Sam's birthday is Saturday the 7th.
Leo Brennan gave Sam a vintage film camera for his birthday, and Sam loved it.
Sam has been taking photos of everything and shot a whole roll of the cat next door with his birthday camera.
Sam loved his Christmas drafting lamp.
Maddie Cho gave Leo Brennan a twelve-inch cast-iron pan, which he seasoned twice before using.
Leo Brennan has sourdough called Gus, which survived the move in a cooler.
Leo Brennan and Maddie Cho's Elk Hollow cabin booking moved from February 14 to 16 to March 27 to 29 because of a forecast snowstorm and possible road closure.
The Elk Hollow booking change was free, and Maddie Cho's $150 deposit carries over.
Leo Brennan still owes Maddie Cho $75 for the Elk Hollow cabin deposit.
Leo Brennan is on breakfast duty at Elk Hollow and is bringing his sourdough Gus and Maddie Cho's cast-iron pan.
Elk Hollow has no Wi-Fi and has a wood stove, and Maddie Cho told Leo Brennan to bring books.
Alex Moreau hosts game nights and is hosting one on Saturday March 7.
Leo Brennan traditionally spends New Year's Eve at Alex Moreau's party.
Maddie Cho and Juni attended Alex Moreau's New Year's Eve party for Maddie's last night in Chicago, and Maddie won the trivia round.
Maddie Cho wants Leo Brennan to tell Alex Moreau she misses game night and that he still owes her a rematch.
Alex and Hana's co-ed baby shower is Saturday March 14, 2 pm, at Hana's parents' house in Evanston.
Leo Brennan's dad started a woodworking class and has a crib 'in progress'.
Maddie Cho moved from Chicago to Denver and arrived Saturday night after 14 hours of driving with Juni.
Maddie Cho's address is 1418 Larkspur Ct, Apt 1, Denver, CO 80211.
Maddie Cho's Colorado phone number is (720) 555-0164, replacing her old Chicago number, which shuts off on February 1.
Maddie Cho lives in a small, cozy ground-floor apartment, where Juni has claimed the window.
Maddie Cho's upstairs neighbor Gloria is a retired music teacher who plays piano at 9 am every day.
Juni is Maddie Cho's dog, and Leo Brennan has dog-sat her.
Juni's new vet is Dr. Ruth Fenn at Highland Vet Clinic.
Leo Brennan gave Maddie Cho a Denver guidebook and Juni a red winter coat for Christmas.
Maddie Cho bought a used gray hatchback with snow tires.
Maddie Cho's landlord is Mr. Ortega.
Maddie Cho's noisy radiator was repaired on Monday and is now quiet.
Maddie Cho loves her new job, where her caseload is mostly toddlers and her boss is Dr. Grant.
Maddie Cho works Monday to Thursday, 7 to 5:30, ten-hour days, with Fridays off.
Maddie Cho's coworker Tasha Reid has befriended her.
Maddie Cho likes the oat latte at Little Kettle Coffee, around the corner from her place.
Maddie Cho takes pottery classes Thursday evenings at Clayhouse Studio.
Maddie Cho plans to make Leo Brennan a mug in pottery class.
Tasha Reid persuaded Maddie Cho to join Basecamp Climbing on Tuesday nights.
Maddie Cho's grandma has been home since January 16, walks with a cane, and does PT twice a week.
Maddie Cho's mom Linda confirmed a Denver visit for February 20 to 23 and is bringing Korean side dishes.
Maddie Cho went on a date with Ethan, a nurse she met at trivia night, and said it was really nice.
Ethan planned to take Maddie Cho to dinner for Valentine's Day, and Juni is suspicious of him.
Maddie Cho is maid of honor for Grace's wedding, with Daniel's sister Lucia as the only other bridal party member.
Leo Brennan offered to help Maddie Cho write a maid-of-honor toast that is both funny and sappy.
Grace's wedding RSVPs are due March 15 on the wedding website, with vegetarian risotto or trout as meal choices.
Leo Brennan promised to RSVP to Grace's wedding during the week of the February 19 conversation.
Maddie Cho is hosting Grace's bridal shower on April 18 in Albuquerque.
Maddie Cho's birthday is March 12.
Maddie Cho wants pottery trimming tools with wooden handles for her birthday, not the plastic kit, because her current tools keep bending.
Leo Brennan completed his interview by 2026-02-25 and thought it went well; they asked a lot about the science fair.
Leo Brennan expects an interview decision by March 13.
Maddie Cho still has Leo Brennan's book The Salt Orchard by her front door next to her keys and had been forgetting to mail it for four months as of 2026-02-25.
Juni hid in the bathtub for two hours during freak thunder-snow the day before 2026-02-25 but was okay afterward.
A weighted blanket helps Juni.
Maddie Cho's mom's visit went perfectly, and she loved Little Kettle.
Maddie Cho's mom and Juni became best friends during her visit.
Maddie Cho's mom completely reorganized her kitchen, leaving Maddie unable to find her spatula.
Leo Brennan's new apartment is on the second floor, and its back porch gets the morning sun.
Leo Brennan and someone else bought a used dining table from a neighbor for $80 for the new apartment.
Gus's new home is on top of Leo Brennan's fridge, where he is thriving.
Leo Brennan completed his first 10-miler on 2026-02-28, and his knee was totally fine, resolving his earlier concern about whether it would cooperate.
Leo Brennan was seven weeks from race day as of 2026-03-01.
Maddie Cho made Leo Brennan a green mug with a wonky handle; it had not arrived as of 2026-03-03, and tracking said Thursday.
Maddie Cho and Ethan are officially a couple as of 2026-03-01.
Ethan is a pediatric nurse at one of the hospitals where Maddie Cho lives.
Juni is warming up to Ethan.
Leo Brennan expects Sam to want a full report about Maddie Cho and Ethan's relationship.
Leo Brennan owes Maddie Cho $75; she said there was no rush and joked that she would write it on his hand when he gets there.
Maddie Cho agreed to cut the second joke about Daniel's welding from her toast draft after Leo Brennan said it was a little mean.
Grace's bridal shower theme is 'desert brunch'.
Maddie Cho ordered 40 tiny cactus favors for Grace's bridal shower.
Leo Brennan's dad, Mike, finished the crib and sent a photo; Leo thought it was beautiful.
Hana cried over the finished crib, and Alex pretended not to.
